accepted_risks.title: Accepted risk: audit-log whole-record tail truncation is undetectable
accepted_risks.detail: The hash chain detects modification, reordering and mid-frame truncation, but deleting whole trailing records leaves a valid shorter chain. Mitigation: ship records off-host or record the head hash externally.

accepted_risks.title: Accepted risk: macOS Keychain secret passed via `security -w` argv
accepted_risks.detail: SecretStore::store passes the value to `security add-generic-password -w`, so for the lifetime of that call it is visible to `ps` for the same user. Reads use `find-generic-password -w`, which prints the value to stdout, not argv.

accepted_risks.title: Duplicate crate versions (foldhash x2, hashbrown x3, syn x2)
accepted_risks.detail: cargo-deny bans=warn. These are transitive, have no advisories, and add only build time and binary size.

accepted_risks.title: Oversized HTTP body returns 400, not 413
accepted_risks.detail: The limit is enforced (DefaultBodyLimit), but because of axum's Json extractor rejection mapping the status code is wrong. This is a cosmetic, not a security, issue.

accepted_risks.title: cargo-audit 0.22.2 release binary has no published checksum
accepted_risks.detail: The local scan used an unverified binary. CI builds cargo-audit from crates.io with --locked.
